verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory/context infrastructure platform, not an agent with its own tool-execution loop — evidence shows Supermemory functions as an MCP *server* (other AI assistants connect to it for memory) and as a documentation MCP for coding agents implementing integrations, not as a client that consumes external MCP servers' tools. This client-side 'plug tools into the product' capability is a category error for a memory-layer product rather than an agent.
